payload.title: prove_candidate_pin registers a recipe that holds the pin's command but not its files, and the pin's content is stored nowhere, so another experiment registered on that recipe runs the command without the pin and its matched, failed observation becomes the latest one the R4 binding reads for the recipe
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/experiment.py:536-540 (the pin's recipe is registered with the command and no files)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/experiment.py:164-211 (_append_recipe: a recipe row has no field for a pin's content)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/experiment.py:387 (run_experiment runs a recipe's command at a commit and knows no pin)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_validator.py:927-933 (the R4 binding reads the latest matched observation per recipe_ref)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per concept: a pin is its files, command, failure signature and expectation together; the recipe is a second, incomplete description of it
payload.notes: Registered by the D6 findings clerk from the D6 review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head ac106b734 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: The pin's content is stored with its proof, and an experiment cannot be registered on a seat_pin recipe (register_experiment refuses it by name), or the pin is not a recipe at all. Test: the probe's P2 raises instead of recording a matched observation.
